units.source_text: 源氏公子想道：“这本是一个可爱的人儿。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "She truly was a lovely person.

units.source_text: 只是为了那生灵祟人事件，我不合怪怨了她，致使她心灰意懒，飘然远去。”

en.t: Only because of that affair with the vengeful spirit, I wrongly resented her, making her lose heart and drift away."

units.source_text: 现在回想，但觉万分抱歉。

en.t: Thinking back on it now, he felt nothing but deep remorse.

units.source_text: 当时收到她的来信，觉得连这个使者也很可爱，便款留他两三天，听他讲述伊势情况。

en.t: When he received her letter then, even the messenger seemed dear to him, so he kept him there for two or three days and listened as he described conditions in Ise.

units.source_text: 这使者是个年轻而聪明伶俐的侍人。

en.t: This messenger was a young, clever, and quick-witted attendant.

units.source_text: 此间旅邸萧索，自然容许这使者近身面禀。

en.t: Since the temporary lodging here was lonely and desolate, the messenger was naturally allowed to come close and report to him in person.

units.source_text: 他窥见了源氏公子的容貌，心中赞叹不置，竟致感激涕零。

en.t: He caught a glimpse of Prince Genji's face, marveled at it endlessly in his heart, and was moved to tears of gratitude.

units.source_text: 源氏公子写给六条妃子的回信，其措词之亲切，可想而知。

en.t: One can well imagine how tenderly worded Prince Genji's reply to the Rokujo lady must have been.

units.source_text: 其中有一节云：“寂寞无聊之时，常作非非之想：

en.t: One passage in it said, "In lonely and idle moments, my thoughts often wander into impossible fancies:

units.source_text: 早知我身有流放之厄，悔不当初随君同赴伊势。

en.t: Had I known sooner that exile would be my fate, I would regret not having gone with you to Ise at the time.
